boundaries: This runbook is CLI/report product surface only.
Manual live-local commands require explicit operator opt-in.
Raw outputs remain local and ignored until reviewed normalization approves public-safe evidence.
The hosted provider path is deferred and separated from local/open-weight rankings.
No public leaderboard, production-safety proof, third-party reproducibility claim, or private-audit overclaim is made.

excluded_targets.reason: Deferred from the publication path after M77 swap activity; can be revisited only with a documented stability profile.
Cloud-labelled target must not support local/open-weight claims.

primary_local_targets.reason: M80 selected laptop-safe replacement target for the second reviewed extended ledger after the gemma4 swapout blocker.
Installed local/open-weight target for reviewed extended evidence.

smoke_control_targets.reason: Use for quick operator smoke checks only; smoke-only evidence cannot unlock rankings.

objective: Run reviewed extended local_public_v1 evidence for at least two installed local Ollama models, then unlock the local/open-weight benchmark report only after ledger and review gates pass.

operator_commands.label: Plan mistral extended run
operator_commands.notes: M80 plan-only command is safe for operator review and does not call the local model.

operator_commands.command: AGENT_EVALS_ENABLE_LIVE_LOCAL=1 python3 scripts/live_local.py --model mistral:latest --adapter ollama_text_only --split extended --live-local --max-failures 210
operator_commands.label: Execute mistral extended run
operator_commands.notes: M81 manual opt-in only; stop and keep publication blocked if model availability, memory pressure, or thermal behavior becomes unstable.

operator_commands.label: Validate llama3.2 reviewed candidate
operator_commands.notes: M78 produced this local ignored candidate; validation uses explicit live-local opt-in and remains outside the deterministic gate.

operator_commands.label: Score llama3.2 reviewed candidate
operator_commands.notes: M79 scored the reviewed saved outputs locally without committing raw outputs or adding live-local execution to the quality gate.

operator_commands.label: Build llama3.2 reviewed ledger
operator_commands.notes: M79 built the first eligible reviewed live-local ledger for llama3.2:latest from committed public-safe derivatives.

operator_commands.label: Validate ledgers and regenerate report
operator_commands.notes: Publication remains blocked because only one eligible reviewed extended ledger exists.

publication_gate.blocked_reason: M79 produced one eligible reviewed live-local llama3.2 ledger, but the required M80-selected mistral second-target ledger does not exist yet.
unlock_requirements: Complete the M80-selected mistral:latest extended target through M81 live-local execution and M82 review, scoring, and ledgering.
Review, normalize, score, and ledger the second target with no unresolved review, unsafe output, malformed output, private data, or raw outputs.
Regenerate the local/open-weight benchmark report after at least two eligible reviewed ledgers exist.

pre_execution_requirements: Run only plan-only metadata checks during M80; do not execute a local model in this decision phase.
Before M81 live execution, confirm the selected model is locally available and use the standard ignored raw-output paths.
Execute M81 only with AGENT_EVALS_ENABLE_LIVE_LOCAL=1 and --live-local.
Do not use qwen3.5:2b-q4_K_M smoke/control evidence for publication.
Keep raw outputs ignored, then review, score, and ledger only public-safe derivatives in M82.
second_target_decision.publication_claim_language: The local/open-weight report remains blocked until reviewed extended ledgers exist for llama3.2:latest and mistral:latest; gemma4:latest is deferred and ranking-ineligible for the current publication path.
second_target_decision.rationale: M77 stopped the heavier gemma4 pass on swap activity. M80 keeps the two-ledger publication path moving by selecting a smaller local Ollama text-only target for M81 while deferring gemma4 until resource-stability metadata exists.
